# Cursor

**One click** (Cursor must be installed):

[![Add to Cursor](https://cursor.com/deeplink/mcp-install-dark.svg)](https://cursor.com/install-mcp?name=gupshup&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL21jcC5ndXBzaHVwLmFpL2VudGVycHJpc2UtYXV0aC9tY3AifQ%3D%3D)

The button opens Cursor's *Install MCP server* dialog; click **Install**. If your browser doesn't hand off to Cursor, paste this link into the address bar:
```
cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=gupshup&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL21jcC5ndXBzaHVwLmFpL2VudGVycHJpc2UtYXV0aC9tY3AifQ%3D%3D
```

Or add to `~/.cursor/mcp.json` (all projects) or `.cursor/mcp.json` (one project):
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gupshup": {
      "url": "https://mcp.gupshup.ai/enterprise-auth/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```
Cursor opens your browser to sign in. When prompted, sign in with your **Gupshup Enterprise account ID and password** for each channel (WhatsApp, SMS, RCS) you want to use, then choose which apps (Analytics, Templates, Campaigns) to allow.

No Gupshup Enterprise account yet? Email [sales@gupshup.ai](mailto:sales@gupshup.ai).

Something not working? See [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md).
